entities.summary: Leszek Laszkiewicz is a Polish ice hockey executive, and former player in professional leagues and member of the Poland men's national ice hockey team. Representing Poland from 1995 to 2015, he played at two European Junior Championships, two World Junior Championships, and eighteen consecutive Ice Hockey World Championships. He appeared in 216 games for the men's national team, scored 89 goals and 150 points, and was the team captain from 2008 to 2011. Nicknamed "Laszka", he received the Torriani Award when inducted into the IIHF Hall of Fame in 2025.
